leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a state variable to store the selected date in a React component
Bind the state variable to a DatePicker component's value prop
Implement a handler function to update state when the date changes
Configure the DatePicker component to use the handler via its onChange prop
Render a controlled DatePicker that displays and updates the selected date
Manipulate the date state to reset or set a default value programmatically
Integrate the controlled DatePicker into a form with other input elements
